messages:
deploy-bot: :bell: staging deploy started for env=staging, commit=b9d7c2a (tag=v3.0.0-rc1). initial traffic 0->5% over 3m. changewindow=2026-03-21T14:00Z..2026-03-21T16:00Z. rollout-strategy=wave-canary.
maya: grabbing commit, running db-migration dry run locally. pulling migration plan from https://confluence.redwood/rel/v3-rc1-migrations
jun: quick heads-up: this build includes new quantization profile (int4) for chat-encoder. flagged in PR #512. might affect peak memory on small GPUs.
sre-oncall: canary smoke reporting GPU OOMs on infer nodes (nodepool: gpu-s-8). logs: ```E/OOM: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory\nstack: ai.infer.GPUAllocator.allocate(GPUAllocator.kt:54)```
release-manager: pause canary traffic. hold on staging. decide mitigation: pin chat-encoder variant to float16, or roll back the quantization change entirely. preference to pin variant if quick.
maya: pin command ready: `rdwctl model pin --env=staging --model=chat-encoder --variant=float16 --scope=canary`
jun: +1 to pin. float16 has slightly higher cost but much safer. prepare rollback steps if pin doesn't resolve OOMs.
deploy-bot: executing: rdwctl model pin --env=staging --model=chat-encoder --variant=float16 --scope=canary (triggered by release-manager)
sre-oncall: pin applied to 2/2 canary nodes. restarting worker pods. verifying memory footprints...
sre-oncall: p95 latency stable, OOMs cleared, GPU memory usage down from ~98% to ~72%. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/metrics/gpu-memory?orgId=1
qa-lead: starting longer inference load test for 10m window. will report errors and quality diffs.
release-manager: keep canary paused for 15m observation, update release notes with mitigation: "chat-encoder pinned to float16 in staging due to int4 OOMs"
jun: created follow-up ticket #517 to root cause int4 allocation regression and add CI OOM smoke test.
qa-lead: load test passed, no regressions in outputs detected. small perf hit (~6% latency increase).
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: staging deploy resumed: traffic 5%->50% (gentle ramp). commit=b9d7c2a (tag=v3.0.0-rc1). applied pins=[chat-encoder:float16].
maya: watching migrations and metrics. DB migrations applied cleanly on staging.
sre-oncall: monitoring steady, no new OOMs, readiness probes green.
deploy-bot: :tada: staging deploy complete. final status=SUCCESS. commit=b9d7c2a tag=v3.0.0-rc1. applied_pins=chat-encoder:float16. timeframe=5850012345->5850012410. release-notes=https://confluence.redwood/rel/v3.0.0-rc1#staging
release-manager: updating release checklist, notifying stakeholders and QA for expanded regression run. thanks all. :rocket:
jun: follow-up: will coordinate a controlled int4 re-test in a sandbox with memory caps before reintroducing.
thread_summary: deploy-bot started staging deploy for v3.0.0-rc1. canary hit GPU OOMs due to new int4 quantization on chat-encoder. team paused rollout, pinned chat-encoder to float16 for canary, verified OOMs cleared and load tests passed with small perf impact, resumed and completed staging deploy. follow-up ticket #517 created for int4 regression investigation.
